Key Takeaways
Attendees included the app's developers, real estate investors, and marketing specialists discussing market expansion and lead generation.
Key issues addressed were foreclosure management, efficient lead handling, and enhancing online presence with targeted ads and content.
The team decided to focus on improving lead quality, leveraging testimonials, and exploring Texas for market opportunities.
